# Voprosy Metodologii — Complete Archive Catalog

## Overview

Archive of the journal Voprosy Metodologii — the print organ of the methodological community founded by G. P. Shchedrovitsky. Published 1991–1999 under the Committee for System-Thought-Activity Methodology and Organizational-Activity Games (USSR), later as an independent journal.

- **Period**: 1991–1999 (1993 — not published)
- **Issues**: 15
- **Pages (JPG)**: 2,274
- **Articles**: 201
- **Format**: JPEG scans (1200×2168 px) + OCR (HTML) + ToC (MD)
- **Author**: Maxim Osovsky (https://www.wikidata.org/wiki/Q107189449)
- **URL**: https://github.com/maximosovsky/voprosy-metodologii
- **License**: CC BY-SA 4.0

---

## How to use with LLMs

1. Load `search-index.json` for structured search across all 201 articles
2. Read individual `.md` files for human-readable tables of contents
3. Read `pages.html` via raw GitHub URLs for full OCR text
4. Use JPG files for visual verification of quotations
